reason: The plugin primarily provides a Web settings marketplace for searching GitHub repositories tagged dsh-plugin, reading their READMEs, and optionally sending README content to the current AI session for installation guidance.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh Web 设置中提供插件市场，用于浏览带有 dsh-plugin 标签的 GitHub 仓库、阅读 README，并可将内容发送给当前会话的 AI 生成安装指引。
summaries.en: Adds a plugin marketplace to dsh Web settings for browsing dsh-plugin repositories on GitHub, reading their READMEs, and optionally sending README content to the current AI session for installation guidance.

capabilities: Fetches repository README content from GitHub or a configurable mirror proxy
Sends fetched README content with a configurable prompt to the current AI session for summarization
Adds a marketplace tab to the Web settings interface
Stores proxy, layout, and prompt preferences in browser local storage
